ai-assistants.title: AI assistants and agents
ai-assistants.summary: Conversational assistants that draw on your internal knowledge and act in your tools.
ai-assistants.description: We design assistants that answer from your documents, guide your customers or employees, and chain actions in your applications, with the right safeguards.

benefits.a: Reliable answers, sourced from your own content
benefits.c: Fewer repetitive tasks for your teams

useCases.c: Agent that prepares files or quotes

document-automation.title: Document automation
document-automation.summary: Automatically extract, classify and check information from your documents.
document-automation.description: Invoices, contracts, forms, mail: we automate how your documents are read and processed, with human validation where it matters.

data-intelligence.title: Analytics and forecasting
data-intelligence.summary: Make the most of your data to anticipate, prioritize and decide.
data-intelligence.description: We build analysis and forecasting models from your data and make them available in dashboards everyone can understand.

generative-content.title: Generative AI for your content
generative-content.summary: Produce and adapt your content faster, in your voice and under your control.
generative-content.description: Writing, summarizing, translating, multichannel adaptation: we set up supervised generation tools that follow your guidelines and review rules.

benefits.c: Human review built into the process

ai-integration.title: AI in your existing tools
ai-integration.summary: Bring AI where your teams already work: CRM, ERP, messaging, intranet.
ai-integration.description: We connect AI models to your existing applications securely, so that AI fits naturally into your processes.

benefits.c: A scalable architecture, not tied to a single vendor

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Help every organization get real value from artificial intelligence, by choosing the right technologies, in the right place, with the right safeguards.

approach.text: We focus on measurable results: start from business needs, prove value quickly, then industrialize rigorously. We stay vendor-independent so we can recommend what truly suits you.
